mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale_lines (sale_id, line_no, product_id, sku, name, quantity, unit_price, discount_per_unit, discount_total, tax_code, tax_overridden, tax_rate, tax_inclusive, tax_amount, promotion_code, line_total) VALUES (#{saleId}, #{lineNo}, #{productId}, #{sku}, #{name}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{discountPerUnit}, #{discountTotal}, #{taxCode}, #{taxOverridden}, #{taxRate}, #{taxInclusive}, #{taxAmount}, #{promotionCode}, #{lineTotal})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sale_lines WHERE sale_id = #{saleId} ORDER BY line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE sale_lines SET returned_qty = returned_qty + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM sale_lines WHERE sale_id = #{saleId} AND returned_qty < quantity
